_what: Overnight run snapshot. The firing cron copies this into run_request.json and pushes.
_desc: Stage 0 of the discount-window reopening: read the account balance and refresh the model catalogue. Mode catalog spends nothing. The fields below mode are inert in this mode and are left at the shape Arm 1 will use, so the staging push that starts Arm 1 changes mode and nothing else.
_why_catalog_first: The queue's remaining-credit figure has never been read from the account; it is arithmetic carried on a prior figure, which is drift_log.md D2-D5. The Arm 1 ceiling is set from registry/probe_runs/<id>-catalog/credits.json or it is not set. The catalogue is refetched in the same round-trip because the discounted-models collection page is unreachable from the development container (403 on CONNECT), so a discount is identified by diffing prices against the pinned catalogue rather than by reading a page.
